limited_guarantees.closed_by: M2A-3 properties that call check_transition over GENERATED bases with every field filled, a dual anchor and a view (the oracle invents no content in the Gold's bases)
limited_guarantees.what: on the Gold's own bases policies, receipt_rules and provenance.{source_amount, year, year_source, buyer_scope, inherited_from} are empty (the Gold carries none), so rebuilding a carried condition with those defaults is invisible there

limited_guarantees.closed_by: M2A-3 passes its own subject-to-dataset table as dataset_of
limited_guarantees.what: the value of a redirected request's dataset is the host table's: without ``dataset_of`` the check is relational (never the old one, never another subject's)
which policies the host re-decides on the composed effective (§6.6) is not determined by the Gold or the contract text: any well-formed policy list over the effective's conditions passes

the effective of a NEW_SEARCH is built by from_acceptance (M2A-1b), not the reducer: only its meaning is compared and ``audit`` reports it as unverified when it is not supplied; no transition is checked

the §20.2 gate «búsqueda nueva y delta confundidos» is certified by M2A-8b with the real producer, not by this oracle: it measures the §7.2 scope only where the facts of P determine it UNIQUELY, reads the absence of every continuation marker as «no evidence» (closed world over the labels) and cannot see the «verb of request» that makes a frame, so every lone content condition is NO_MEDIBLE for classification

limited_guarantees.closed_by: check_transition T-COND-REMOVAL on any input that exercises it (killed by f16_any_value)
limited_guarantees.what: a reducer that inverts the polarity of the single positive of a slot whatever the value of the negative SET is not discriminated by the Gold: no applicable case sets a negative of another value over a single positive
a reducer whose SET of one polarity removes the other polarity of the dimension is not discriminated by the Gold: no applicable case carries both polarities of a dimension through a SET
a reducer whose CLEAR of a dimension leaves its negative conditions is not discriminated by the Gold: no applicable case clears a dimension that holds a negative condition

limited_guarantees.closed_by: a Gold case that executes a compatible territory over a carried buyer, with the buyer's territory typed
limited_guarantees.what: a reducer that over-fires H6 (a clarification for any new territory next to a buyer) is not discriminated: no applicable EXECUTE case has a territory next to a carried buyer, and the two cases where H6 fires are NO_MEDIBLE(HOST_FACT_NOT_IN_GOLD:CARRIED_BUYER_TERRITORY)

limited_guarantees.closed_by: a Gold that carries the typed fact in its IR, or a decision to derive it from the adjudicated outcome
limited_guarantees.what: H6, H7 and H8 read a fact the Gold's IR does not carry (the carried buyer's territory, the closed list of regions, the states of the resulting universe): section 19 says LECTURA for them, so they are not reds, but the oracle will not type the fact by guessing. A case where the Gold expects the rule to FIRE is NO_MEDIBLE with the fact named, and so is every case where H8 READS the literals whatever the outcome: a change of universe with a STATE or MODALITY standing (§14). An EXECUTE control stays measurable only when no rule reads a missing fact

limited_guarantees.closed_by: E-VALUE and E-TIME typed values in the Gold's IR
limited_guarantees.what: a §19 dependency with impacto LECTURA does not block, but a case whose value the Gold does not give typed stays NO_MEDIBLE with the typing motive: a month without a year (TIME_MONTH_HINT), a SMMLV amount whose IR has no single catalogued year (SMMLV_YEAR_NOT_SINGLE, SMMLV_YEAR_NOT_CATALOGUED: the clock is not in the Gold, the catalogue is closed), a relative window the hint does not state (TIME_RELATIVE_WINDOW_NOT_EXPLICIT)

limited_guarantees.closed_by: E-GEO's closed list of regions and members in the Gold's IR
limited_guarantees.what: a REGION is typed with ONE synthetic member derived from its name (the Gold carries no members; compose never reads them, §19 DEP-REGION is LECTURA): a reducer that validates a region against E-GEO's closed list would reject it, and H7 is measured only where the Gold executes

limited_guarantees.closed_by: M2A-3 properties over bases with a logic expression, using the IR v2 shape
limited_guarantees.what: TARGET_NOT_ADDRESSABLE (precedence 1) needs the shape of the IR v2 logic expression to know that an op targets an atom inside an OR/NOT group: check_transition never finds it, and accepts it unjudged over a base with a logic

limited_guarantees.closed_by: the authorities' own gates and the Gold cases
limited_guarantees.what: OP_NOT_ACCREDITED of an op whose authority did not resolve cannot be written in a m2a-patch/1 (it carries only resolved conditions): check_transition finds the causes the dicts show (F16 fail-closed, P-3, incomparable units). With ``refusal=`` it rejects a code outside annex A.3 and an OP_NOT_ACCREDITED over a dimension no op touches; what remains is accepted unjudged: an authority refusal over a dimension an op touches, and any A.3 code of a host rule or of the protocol (the Gold decides them by case; SF194's mark is compose's, not an authority's)

F16's other fail-closed branch, a negated value CONTAINED in a positive (G-FU-09), needs a notion of containment no typed value gives: check_transition decides the several-positives and same-patch branches only

the host rules H1-H11 need the conversational context (expiry, pending, authority readings): the transition oracle only checks that a host-rule code never replaces a refusal cause; the Gold decides them by case

a reducer that keeps the old universe kind after REPLACE_UNIVERSE is not discriminated by the Gold: no applicable case changes the kind (SF075, records to opportunities, is declared dependent downstream)

transition_rules.demands: the effective has exactly the keys of m2a-accepted/1; unique request and condition ids; every reference to a request resolves; a dual anchor shares its scope; every policy is well formed and names conditions of the effective; at most one condition per VALUE side, ORDER and CARDINALITY; no CARDINALITY without ORDER

a patch with a refusal cause produces NO effective: two SET (or two SET_ORDER, or two REPLACE_UNIVERSE) on one slot; KEEP with CLEAR, or KEEP with SET/SET_ORDER/REPLACE_UNIVERSE, of one slot EVEN WHEN THE VALUES COINCIDE (R3b, U22); KEEP of an empty slot; a negative SET of a value that is one of several carried positives, or whose positive the same patch creates (F16 fail-closed, R3-4, P-3); a VALUE bound against a carried opposite bound of incomparable units (§15.2); a composed state that leaves a CARDINALITY standing without ORDER (R3-1, decided on the STATE, not on the op); and a lone CLEAR of an empty slot (H12)

transition_rules.clause: §6 step 3b (closed precedence of causes), §6 table (A.3 code per DeltaRefusal)
transition_rules.demands: a refused patch is refused with the code of the HIGHEST-precedence cause (TARGET_NOT_ADDRESSABLE > DELTA_SLOT_CONFLICT > KEEP_ON_EMPTY_SLOT > OP_NOT_ACCREDITED:<DIM> > DELTA_LEAVES_CARDINALITY_WITHOUT_ORDER), with ties decided by the §4.2 slot order and the dimension of the slot named in OP_NOT_ACCREDITED; a host-rule code never replaces a cause (causes precede §6 step 4); a code outside the vocabulary of annex A.3 and the DeltaRefusal list is no refusal at all

a structural refusal (DELTA_SLOT_CONFLICT, KEEP_ON_EMPTY_SLOT, DELTA_LEAVES_CARDINALITY_WITHOUT_ORDER, TARGET_NOT_ADDRESSABLE over a base without logic) over a patch with no such cause refuses a lawful transition; OP_NOT_ACCREDITED:<DIM> (or its A.3 publication) names a dimension some op of the patch touches
without REPLACE_UNIVERSE the effective has exactly the base's requests; with it, exactly one: the named subject's (a dual anchor keeps the named one and the other disappears) or the single one

transition_rules.clause: §6.3 (identity of what no op touches); user decision R3
transition_rules.demands: an untouched request is byte-identical to the base's in EVERY field: request_id, scope_id, subject, universe_kind, universe_origin, view, dataset

transition_rules.clause: §5.2 (REPLACE_UNIVERSE changes subject and kind), §3.2 (request_id, scope_id and view belong to the request); user decision R3 (request_id, scope_id)
transition_rules.demands: a request touched by REPLACE_UNIVERSE keeps request_id, scope_id and view: only subject, universe_kind, universe_origin and dataset change (neither §5.2 nor §3.2 says the redirect rewrites the view)
the redirected request has the op's subject and universe kind
the redirected request's universe_origin is the origin of the CURRENT PatchOp
the redirected request's dataset is the one that corresponds to its new subject
a carried condition is byte-identical to the base's (value, authority, policies, origin, provenance, condition_id); only request_ids may be rewritten, and only when a dual anchor is reduced
a placed condition is the patch's, unchanged but for condition_id and request_ids (ids are the reducer's: a patch condition may collide with a base id)
every condition of the effective is carried from the base or placed from the patch: none is fabricated

transition_rules.clause: §5.2 (SET sustituye la ranura; CLEAR la quita)
transition_rules.demands: a base condition in a slot an op writes is not carried

a base condition absent from the effective has an op on its slot, or is a declared substitution checked on the typed values: A8.1 (a VALUE bound against the patch's new opposite bound that leaves the interval empty or degenerate) or F16 (the single positive of a slot against a negative SET of the same value)
a negative SET whose canonical value is the single carried positive of its slot INVERTS it: the positive does not survive next to its own negation (an effective with +X and -X of one canonical value)
every SET / SET_ORDER of the patch is placed exactly once: no op is applied partially or twice
a condition's request_ids are the base's when the request ids are unchanged; when a dual anchor is reduced they are rewritten to the effective's request ids; a placed condition applies to all of them

a VALUE interval that is empty or degenerate is never produced by a follow-up with the opposite bound carried (two bounds of the same patch are the user's request; two carried ones are the base's own)
a base without logic (the AND of all) yields an effective without logic: the closed ops create no group
